1.web: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.
1.asv: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, namely, of Shem, Ham, and Japheth: and unto them were sons born after the flood.

2.web: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
2.asv: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.

3.web: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.
3.asv: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.

4.web: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
4.asv: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

5.web: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.
5.asv: Of these were the isles of the nations divided in their lands, every one after his tongue, after their families, in their nations.

6.web: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
6.asv: And the sons of Ham: Cush, and Mizraim, and Put, and Canaan.

7.web: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.
7.asv: And the sons of Cush: Seba, and Havilah, and Sabtah, and Raamah, and Sabteca; and the sons of Raamah: Sheba, and Dedan.

8.web: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.
8.asv: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be a mighty one in the earth.

9.web: He was a mighty hunter before Yahweh. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before Yahweh”.
9.asv: He was a mighty hunter before Jehovah: wherefore it is said, Like Nimrod a mighty hunter before Jehovah.

10.web: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
10.asv: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babel, and Erech, and Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

11.web: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,
11.asv: Out of that land he went forth into Assyria, and builded Nineveh, and Rehoboth-Ir, and Calah,

12.web: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.
12.asv: and Resen between Nineveh and Calah (the same is the great city).

13.web: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
13.asv: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

14.web: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.
14.asv: and Pathrusim, and Casluhim (whence went forth the Philistines), and Caphtorim.

15.web: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,
15.asv: And Canaan begat Sidon his first-born, and Heth,

16.web: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,
16.asv: and the Jebusite, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

17.web: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,
17.asv: and the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

18.web: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.
18.asv: and the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite: and afterward were the families of the Canaanite spread abroad.

19.web: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.
19.asv: And the border of the Canaanite was from Sidon, as thou goest toward Gerar, unto Gaza; as thou goest toward Sodom and Gomorrah and Admah and Zeboiim, unto Lasha.

20.web: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.
20.asv: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, in their nations.

21.web: Children were also born to Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, the elder brother of Japheth.
21.asv: And unto Shem, the father of all the children of Eber, the elder brother of Japheth, to him also were children born.

22.web: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.
22.asv: The sons of Shem: Elam, and Asshur, and Arpachshad, and Lud, and Aram.

23.web: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.
23.asv: And the sons of Aram: Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Mash.

24.web: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.
24.asv: And Arpachshad begat Shelah; and Shelah begat Eber.

25.web: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.
25.asv: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; for in his days was the earth divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.

26.web: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
26.asv: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

27.asv: and Hadoram, and Uzal, and Diklah,

28.asv: and Obal, and Abimael, and Sheba,

29.web: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
29.asv: and Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab: all these were the sons of Joktan.

30.web: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.
30.asv: And their dwelling was from Mesha, as thou goest toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

31.web: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.
31.asv: These are the sons of Shem, after their families, after their tongues, in their lands, after their nations.

32.web: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these in the earth after the flood.
32.asv: These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and of these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.
